title: The Charitable Calcification
logline: A revered doctor discovers that the free miracle nerve-tonic they distributed across multiple systems years ago causes lethal neural calcification, and must fight their own grateful patients to recall the remaining stock.

roles.description: Synthesized the miracle sedative and gave the patent away for free; consumed by guilt over its delayed side effects.
Leads the regional haulers' mutual-aid network; fiercely protective of the tonic supply keeping his drivers functional.
Regional health authority director; eager to cover up administrative negligence in certifying the tonic years ago.
An armed converted freighter hauling bulk tonic carboys between outlying industrial systems.
A self-funded network of long-haul pilots and miners who rely on the tonic to suppress cockpit tremors.
A volunteer dispensary in the core system where the tonic was first given to the public.
A sealed biogel biopsy demonstrating terminal crystal growth in long-term tonic users.

public_situation: Haulers across three systems celebrate the fifth anniversary of the free nerve tonic that cured regional cockpit tremors, while shipments suddenly begin disappearing in transit.
private_truth: The doctor who gave the formula away discovered it causes spinal crystallization after five years, and is hiring corsairs to hijack and incinerate her own charitable shipments.

beats.public_change: The clinic depot posts emergency listings for clinical data transit and chemical sample recovery.

missions.reason: She needs her confidential clinical necropsy logs delivered to a neutral station lab before the regional health ministry impounds her research.
missions.private_fact: Her own sibling was the first long-term patient to suffer total motor paralysis from the formula.

missions.reason: She needs unadulterated chemical baseline canisters collected from a retired lab chemist before health inspectors seal the storage vault.
missions.private_fact: The baseline canisters prove the original synthesis was pure and the toxicity only emerges after prolonged metabolic storage.

beats.public_change: Mutual aid freighters report anomalous sensor jamming and intercepted cargo pods near the system jump lane.

missions.reason: He wants an outside scout to scan a disabled relief transport in the neighboring system and determine why its tonic tanks were deliberately breached.
missions.private_fact: He suspects the corporate pharmaceutical cartel is sabotaging their free supply to force pilots back to commercial meds.

beats.public_change: The mutual aid society mobilizes armed gunboats to escort the remaining tonic convoys.

missions.reason: She needs the master distribution ledger recovered from an armed mutual-aid escort ship so she can track down every contaminated batch.
missions.private_fact: She knows revealing the truth will destroy the mutual aid union and likely trigger lynch mobs against her staff.

beats.public_change: The last bulk runner makes a desperate dash across the regional gate network toward outlying mining settlements.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to intercept the runner and destroy its chemical tanks before the cargo is dispensed to thousands of miners.
missions.private_fact: The runner captain hails mid-fight offering their entire cargo manifest of refined thorium fuel rods if the pilot lets the medicine pass.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the tonic runner's tanks and secures the clinical proof.
resolutions.summary: {role:penitent_doctor} publicly confesses the toxicity. The tonic is purged across three systems, saving thousands from paralysis while destroying {role:veterans_mutual_aid}'s trust.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary blew up the charity medicine fleet after doctors admitted the tonic was slowly turning spines to glass.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the runner's offer, or the convoy escapes.
resolutions.summary: {role:veterans_mutual_aid} distributes the tonic across the outlying belt. Pilots fly symptom-free for another year before irreversible paralysis begins setting in.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took escort pay to push the workers' medicine through despite strange quarantine warnings.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot diverts the logs, loses baseline canisters, or fails to engage.
resolutions.summary: {role:sanitary_commissioner} quietly seals the research files to avoid government liability, letting the toxic tonic circulate until patients drop.

loose_threads.detail: A regional patent registry reveals that a shell corporation owned by the health commissioner filed a synthesized antidote claim two days before the recall.
The confiscated chemical barrels carry batch numbers assigned to a decommissioned naval stimulant depot that burned twelve years ago.

radio_hooks: Hauler unions denounce unprovoked raids on {role:free_clinic_depot} supply convoys across {system}.
Regional health bureau denies rumors of emergency pharmaceutical recall, citing 'seasonal inventory auditing'.
Dispensary lines stretch around orbital rings as miners rush to stockpile free nerve tonic.

voice_direction.penitent_doctor: Trembling, haunted voice with rapid technical self-corrections. Avoids emotional appeals, clinging to clinical statistics like a shield.
voice_direction.veteran_convoy_master: Grizzled, booming baritone thick with righteous defiance. Uses familial warmth when speaking of fellow pilots.
voice_direction.sanitary_commissioner: Polished bureaucratic tone, speaking in passive-voice platitudes designed to diffuse institutional culpability.
